neighbours.label: how a body or organism reacts to / tolerates a stimulus (fires on ' to' or the manner word after react, respond, take well, cope, learn best)
neighbours.short: reacting / tolerating (how well X takes to Y)
fire: Many patients respond badly to the new blood pressure drug.
Our old cat reacts strongly to the smell of vinegar.
Some people react differently to caffeine than others do.
My stomach does not take well to spicy food anymore.
Roses respond well to a little extra fertilizer in spring.
His eyes are very sensitive to bright sunlight.
Elderly horses cope poorly with sudden changes in diet.
Most toddlers learn best through play and repetition.
quiet: Many patients wrote letters to the new hospital director.
Our old cat walks slowly to the kitchen every morning.
Some people responded quickly to the survey we emailed them.
My brother does not drive well to the airport at night.
Roses were given to every guest at the spring wedding.
His eyes turned to the bright window across the room.
Elderly horses were moved to a new barn last winter.
Most toddlers go to bed before eight o'clock.
